PART 2 IS THE UPDATE ON THE SEDATION NEGLIGENCE CASE.

RESPONSE TO THEIR NONSENSE.

1. THEY KILLED MY CAT! A healthy 2-year-old cat arrived with a fecal impaction. She had already undergone the same procedure several times with other veterinarians there. Yesterday, I saw a new group of vets. It was 7:00 PM, and in their haste to perform the procedure, they overdid the anesthesia and/or perforated her intestine. They told me it was normal and that she would wake up, until she went into cardiac arrest and nothing could be done. Furthermore, THEY DID NOT RUN BLOOD TESTS BEFORE SEDATION. They didn't know her oxygen saturation or blood sugar levels. THESE ARE NEGLIGENT AND THEY KILLED A HEALTHY CAT. I understand they want to go home and rest, BUT YOU DON'T PLAY WITH A LIFE. The so-called veterinarian who treated my cat is named María, so be very careful if this woman neglects your cats. The assistant left looking like things had been done wrong, and this woman, without a shred of empathy, said everything was fine.
María: you should have seen my kitten convulsing because of your negligence and lack of professionalism.

2. The veterinarians at this center, as expected, have not taken responsibility. The "veterinarian," Alejandro, presumably the one in charge of the center, said that the cat was in perfect condition when she left the clinic. I have photos and videos from two different days of the same procedure, and the cat didn't come out the same. Please, for the love you have for your pets, don't go to this veterinary clinic.

This same person told me that to perform a dental cleaning on my cat, they would first sedate her, and then, once sedated, they would do blood work to see how the cat was doing. You don't need to be a veterinarian, or particularly bright, to know that pre-operative procedures are necessary before anesthesia. Anyway, my cat won't be coming back, but their cats won't fall into the hands of these people.

RESPONSE: Indeed, the kitten had a chronic problem, which had already been treated at their clinic many times by other veterinarians (Carmen and Lidia), who always performed blood tests to see if they could sedate her. On September 4th, when María saw her, at 7:30 PM, apparently, being a rather irresponsible person, she decided to administer sedation without checking on the kitten's condition. Likewise, as you yourself say, we have photos and videos of other procedures and of the one performed by María the day she killed her, and Lina came out completely different from how she usually appeared. Lina didn't come out drugged; she came out alert and meowing.

We called you several times, Alejandro, to ask about Lina's condition, and you didn't answer a single call. I suppose it's because that incompetent woman had already told you that you'd messed up and Lina was going to die. Besides, in the call you just had with my mom (very sly, by the way), it was already pointed out to you that it's the vet's responsibility to say that if Lina is still drugged or whatever in an hour, she should be taken to the emergency room. That pseudo-vet, completely lacking in empathy, said, "It's normal, she'll pass in a little while." And guess what? We're not vets. That's clear negligence on Maria's part, which the veterinary association will have to investigate. Even though it's Friday night and Maria works with LIVES, if she was tired, she could have told us to go the next day to get Lina seen. But what difference does it make, right? One more life, one less life, after all, they're not your pets.

The fact is that Lina entered your clinic alive and well, and leaving was a death sentence for her. I fully stand by my accusations against the negligent veterinarian and your clinic.
It was only once for a vaccine, and everything seemed fine.
My dog ​​and my cat are always treated very well ✨

I went there for a while because I lived nearby and it was convenient, but it's very expensive; you pay €50 every time you go, even if they don't do anything for your pet. It's worth finding another vet. You usually pay when they prescribe treatment, but checking on your dog's progress the following week shouldn't cost €50 because you're just going to tell them how it went, they check the heartbeat and eyes, and then you go home.
I went to get a deworming pill for my cat, which usually costs between €3 and €5, and they charged me €9.95 without giving me a receipt. I won't be back.

My cat has been going to this vet since she was just three months old. The staff is amazing; they've all made both me and my cat feel incredibly comfortable. They've seen my pet through some very difficult times, and without them, I don't think Nina's improvement would have been possible. We've been going to this vet for two years now, and we've never had a single problem.
Very good veterinary clinic, very professional with a pleasant and friendly approach.
Great service for my pet, we've been going here for two years now, ever since we moved to the area

My experience at this clinic was not good.

I took a rescued cat there with a significant respiratory problem, as well as a parasitic infestation related to that respiratory issue.

After several consultations, the treatment she received was insufficient, and I had to go to another veterinarian for a second opinion.

At this second clinic, they performed new tests, reviewed the X-rays, and expanded the treatment. They even referred her to the hospital, where she had to be admitted for two days due to the severity of her respiratory condition. As of today, the cat is still being evaluated for a problem that could be more complex than initially thought.

I can't say what the final diagnosis will be, but I can say that I was left with the feeling that they didn't investigate enough and that some important possibilities weren't considered from the beginning.

It's worth highlighting the complete lack of safety in the laboratory they use. Despite sending fecal samples from three different days, the only thing the analysis showed was dysbiosis. Another veterinarian, simply by examining the perianal area, saw that it was full of eggs, and the feces produced while the animal was hospitalized were also full of larvae and eggs, to the point of causing a significant case of pulmonary parasitosis.

As the owner, this situation has caused me a great deal of distress, numerous veterinary visits, and considerable expense that could perhaps have been avoided or reduced with a more thorough approach from the beginning.

For all these reasons, I personally would never return to this clinic.
Every time we go they make us wait and serve us late, plus my cat always ends up with her nails untrimmed because if they're in a hurry they don't do it...Please improve this.

I think it's one of the best veterinary clinics, both professionally and as people. Yesterday, my dog ​​had eye surgery, and they couldn't have been better. It's been our trusted clinic for about 10 years, and I'm happier with them every day. I have complete confidence in them treating my dog; I know he's in excellent hands. Thank you so much to the entire Reino Animal team. You're the best.
The service is spectacular.
Very professional and attentive to our little four-legged friends, they have become our trusted veterinarian
I highly recommend this clinic. They have always taken excellent care of my Chihuahua, Iris, including after her spaying, and she was left without a scar. Very professional!
I am very grateful to everyone at the clinic who tried their best to help my kitten Auri. They are very professional, honest, and kind.

I took my dog ​​for a dental cleaning and the price was outrageous!! 173 euros! I went there because it looked good; I'd previously been to another clinic where the same service cost less than 90 euros! On top of that, they didn't give me a receipt or even ask if I wanted a copy of the payment! I'll never go back!
Good service
Both the vet and the reception staff are very friendly! Thank you!

I took my elderly cat to the clinic several times for age-related ailments. Thanks to Carmen and Lidia, my pet is now enjoying a wonderful quality of life in her twilight years. I couldn't be more grateful to the team at this clinic. I also want to thank Floribel at reception, who always has a smile and is available to help with anything needed. I also want to mention that the services are excellent value for money. Highly recommended.
My dog and I had a great experience at the clinic! The employees are so kind, attentive, and patient. Thank you! 😊 …
I have been taking my dog ​​to this vet for 5 years and the service is excellent and the staff very friendly.
Excellent! Every time I take my pet, the service is so much better. They improve every day. It's a pleasure to have such kind professionals. The service is a 10 out of 10. Thank you so much!
Excellent service and attention for both pets and owners. ♿✅ They have a wide variety of services, accessories, toys, and treats. 🐕 …
Thank you so much for your feedback!
We went for the first time and the vet was very nice, the only thing is to make an appointment in advance because it's always full.

I received excellent treatment from Toña; she was very attentive and caring with my dog.
She answered all my questions. She's very flexible with appointment scheduling. Of all the veterinarians who have worked at the clinic, she is undoubtedly the best by far.
She continues to be just as loving with animals; it's clear she loves what she does. I will definitely return.

I'm very unhappy with what was until recently my go-to veterinary clinic. I've had several experiences that have left me with doubts, but the last one was the final straw.

I have a 15-year-old cat with a chronic cough who was once diagnosed with "asthma" in a rather dubious way: after several tests with no clear results, they prescribed Ventolin. One of those "tests" was a €150 dental cleaning, which had no direct relation to the cough, but they justified it as a possible throat infection. Interestingly, if you read below in a review of a dog with a 5-star rating, they also recommended one. Even so, we trusted them and continued the treatment, which at least stabilized her condition.

Now, a little over a year later, and after requesting the prescription three times, they've denied it, claiming they haven't seen the cat recently. They're demanding another visit to prescribe it. The reason? They say "they can't prescribe without seeing the animal." But it was precisely this clinic that prescribed that medication without a firm diagnosis, and now they refuse to renew it unless I pay for another appointment, even though the cat's condition remains unchanged.

Furthermore, on one occasion I was forced to restrain my other cat roughly during an abdominal ultrasound, without adequate assistance from the staff. That experience made me reconsider whether I wanted to continue trusting this place.

Finally, when I expressed my dissatisfaction at reception, the person who attended me laughed in my face when I mentioned that the doctor was requesting another visit just to write a prescription.

In short: be very careful with clinics that, under a professional guise, may prioritize financial interests over animal welfare. It's not always easy to know if they are recommending something necessary or if they are simply exploiting your concerns as a pet owner.

For my part, I will not be returning.
Thank you for your feedback!

I took my kitten there and I'm so happy with the care she received; the treatment was perfect. Plus, you leave feeling reassured because they explain everything very well about what your pet might have.
Super nice and efficient
Very kind.
Thank you very much, Cristobal!

I am very grateful to surgeon Alejandro and his entire team for their excellent and highly professional care. My dog ​​is doing very well, thanks to God and to him for being so professional. Excellent work!

Forever grateful to Alejandro and his entire team. They not only lovingly cared for my Chessy, but they also supported us. They did everything they could to help us and guided us every step of the way with enormous hearts. Their human and professional qualities were outstanding; they were simply the best.
Veterinarians with great dedication and a close relationship with their patients.
Thank you so much for your feedback!
They took very good care of my pet, although they were a little behind schedule with the appointment time.
Thank you for your feedback!
Everything was great, very professional and friendly.

Terrible experience.
I have an 11-year-old Bichon Maltese. My parents took her to the vet months ago (around mid-2024) for a dental cleaning. Before the procedure, we asked for a complete checkup, as we didn't want to put her through the wringer due to her advanced age and the associated risks of anesthesia. They assured us she was perfectly healthy; my mother emphasized her heart condition because we'd noticed she was breathing a little strangely, but they insisted she was as healthy as could be. So, we had her teeth cleaned and extracted.
A few months later, we took her back because her teeth were bad again, and we had her cleaned again, this time with the assurance that she was perfectly fine.

We started noticing our dog was unwell; some days she could barely lift her head. We decided to take her to another clinic where, after listening to her heart, they told us she had a grade 2 heart murmur... and not only that, but she also had a very serious tooth infection. Completely unprofessional. They don't care about anything as long as they make money. I don't recommend them. If anything happens to our dog, we will be taking legal action.
Thank you so much for your feedback!
✅ "Thank you for your feedback! If you have any comments or suggestions, we'd love to hear them. 😊" …
The secretary was not friendly at all. I'm going to change vets. I called them for an emergency and they couldn't even take 5 minutes to look at my dog.

My dog ​​had diarrhea and vomiting. They treated him and were very attentive. They performed all the necessary tests and listened to my concerns and questions. If my dog ​​showed any symptoms, they took care of him. I was very pleased and will be taking my dog ​​there from now on.
Thank you so much for your feedback!
Our team greatly appreciates your feedback!
Thank you for your feedback.
Excellent clinic, Gabriela is a great veterinary doctor.
Thank you so much for your feedback!
Your feedback means a lot to us. Thank you for choosing us!
Thank you so much for your feedback!

Alejandro and the girls are magnificent professionals.
My dog, who has a chronic illness, couldn't be in better hands.

I've been a client of this clinic for the 12 years my beloved dog has been with me, and I can only say positive things about all the professionals and the care they gave her and us as her owners from beginning to end. Their dedication and care can only be a sign of the passion and professionalism they put into their work. THANK YOU SO MUCH! I can't recommend you to anyone who tells me about their pets.

Great professionals and even better people. Since I started taking my cat there, I haven't had a single problem. They've always responded incredibly quickly and always resolved the issue. I recommend them 100%.
I've been taking my dog ​​to this clinic for 12 years and they're all fantastic! Thank you so much!
A terrible experience, they have no idea how to treat birds. Luckily I changed clinics and noticed the difference, both me and my bird, from the first day.

Every time I go, even for a simple consultation, they try to sell you something to get you to pay. I have insurance, and the consultations are free, but they always try to sell you some medication, injection, vitamin gummies, cream, you name it... You pay for it because they prescribe it, but some things aren't really necessary. For example, an injection for vomiting if the dog hasn't vomited for hours, and I only went to check to make sure he was okay. I left with the same information I arrived with, and on top of that, they took my money.
Some vets are very nice, but when I get the guy, it always costs me at least €50, and he doesn't do a single thing (not counting the consultation, which is free with insurance). It's clear that all they care about is money. I don't think I'll be going back. Besides, I'm seeing other reviews that describe similar experiences.

They've been treating my dog ​​for five years. Everyone is caring, attentive, and they listen to what you've observed, explaining everything very clearly. Ever since she was a puppy, Kala has been very happy with her veterinarians and lets them care for and pamper her. Thank you for your attention and dedication.
Excellent service and very affectionate with my pet.
Thank you so much for your feedback!

The best vet in Madrid, I'm sure of it!! Alejandro, Vanessa, and Lili have always been the best when I've taken my Ringo for a checkup. They take care of him, pamper him, and help him get better 🥹

100% recommended 🫶🏼
Thank you for your feedback!
